eyebrow: Same host, two very different views
code:
Unauthenticated scan:
  port 443 open -> web service banner only

Authenticated scan (logs in via SMB/WinRM/SSH):
  + full installed software list + exact versions
  + missing OS patches
  + local config / registry settings
caption: Credentials let the scanner see the host from the inside, not just from the network.
